Game Overview

Flying Bird puts players into a animal experience centered on guide your bird through an endless aerial adventure, mastering the art of timing and precision. Navigate hoops and dodge obstacles with quick reflexes, all while tallying up points. Keep a steady tap rhythm to maintain control and balance, turning challenges into soaring achievements. Will you rise to the occasion?
